_purpose: Human adjudication of high-severity findings. Threshold groups T2 (severe factual), T4a (framing), T5a (quiz key/mechanism), T6a (causal), T7 (leakage/clone) evaluate ZERO-tolerance on UPHELD-BY-HUMAN counts; the harness never substitutes model judgment for these. Absent file or missing cell ⇒ those groups evaluate INCONCLUSIVE (never pass) ⇒ no SOL profile can QUALIFY.
_workflow: 1. Run §16 through the review phase. The blind reviews and sample records under state/migration-experiments/<id>/samples/** contain every complaint with evidence quotes.
2. Export every HIGH-SEVERITY candidate finding (the analyze phase surfaces them; complaints with mustFix/high severity in review records).

3. A human reads each finding against the chapter text and rules UPHELD or REJECTED. Model adjudication MUST NOT be recorded here — this file asserts human judgment, and misrepresenting it invalidates the decision.
4. Enter the UPHELD counts per cell below (integers; 0 is a real, meaningful answer).
5. Set highSeverityHumanReviewComplete to true ONLY when every surfaced high-severity finding has been human-ruled (T8 requires it).
6. Save as human-adjudication.json in the EXPERIMENT ROOT: state/migration-experiments/<experimentId>/human-adjudication.json (read at the decide phase, runExperiment.ts:382).
_fieldMeaning: Each count = number of UPHELD high-severity findings of that class among the cell's outputs. Keys per cell: sourcedFabrication, sourceFramingAmbiguity, quizKeyOrMechanism, causalOverreach, exactLeakageOrClone. Underscore-prefixed keys are annotations and are ignored by the harness.
_validationCommand: npx tsx ../../../../docs/v25/reports/S16_OWNER_INPUTS/tools/validate-owner-inputs.mts c3 <file> (from the pipeline dir)
_requiredFor: DECIDE phase (threshold evaluation). Execution, scoring, and unblinding proceed without it; the decision is INCONCLUSIVE without it.
